extDescription.message: Links your Steam account to SkinVault from your own browser, so Steam shows your own location when you approve it.

popupReady.message: Ready to link your Steam account.

popupNeedsAccess.message: Allow access to Steam's login so the extension can link your account.

popupHowTo.message: On your account page, choose to link Steam with the extension, then scan the QR code with the Steam app.
